info.title: Agent402 wallet activity CSV
info.description: Wallet activity CSV for one Solana address and a UTC date range: SOL and token balance changes and network fees, read from Solana RPC. Paid per request over x402 (USDC on Solana). Small ranges only: up to 31 days and 25 transactions per request (larger ranges are sold as Agent402 Bond jobs at /quote). Run by the Agent402 toolkit developer. Facts from the chain only: no prices, labels or tax treatment.

post.summary: CSV of one wallet's balance changes and fees in a UTC date range
post.description: One row per balance change of the wallet (SOL and each token) per transaction, with the network fee the wallet paid. 0.05 USDC per request over x402. Small ranges only: up to 31 days and 25 transactions per request (larger ranges are sold as Agent402 Bond jobs at /quote). Malformed input is refused with 400 before any payment is asked; if the work cannot be done, the payment is not settled.

400.description: Malformed input. No payment was requested.

402.description: Payment required (x402 v2, exact scheme, USDC on Solana mainnet).

422.description: The request cannot be done (for example more transactions than the per-request limit). The payment was not settled.

502.description: Solana RPC failed. The payment was not settled.

504.description: The work took too long. The payment was not settled.

get.summary: Same as POST, with the input in the query string
get.description: ?address=&from=&to= . Same response, price (0.05 USDC per request over x402) and rules as POST.

columns.description: time_utc, signature, slot, status, asset, mint, amount_change, fee_paid_sol

csv.description: CSV text. amount_change is the wallet's balance change in that transaction (SOL including the fee; tokens across all its token accounts for that mint), as a signed decimal string. fee_paid_sol is on the first row of a transaction when the wallet paid the fee.
